evidence: Every package manifest in the repository is accompanied by a lockfile pinning its full transitive dependency tree
expected_output: One observation row per package manifest with manifest, lockfile, lockfile_present

assertions.description: Every package manifest has a lockfile — without one the installed tree is unreproducible and silently movable.

notes: M1 checks the npm-family manifests at the repo root; other ecosystems join as repo-facts grows.

plain.checks: For every package manifest in the repository, checks that a lockfile sits beside it recording the exact version of every dependency, direct and transitive.
plain.violation: Two installs of the same commit can produce different code. A build that worked yesterday can pull a different version today, and evidence gathered about one install says nothing about the next.
plain.fix: Run the install once and commit the lockfile it writes — package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock. Keep it in version control: a lockfile listed in .gitignore is the same as no lockfile.
